title: JPAIS Judicial Decisions & Legal Ontology
description: Pilot corpus (about 10 kB) for the JPAIS legal retrieval system: a small legal ontology of Indonesian judicial decision-making (deliberation, confidentiality, e-court rules, draft PERMA review), 8 Commercial Court bankruptcy/PKPU test cases, a self-run 3-question benchmark and a reference note on UU 1/2024. Compiled by hand; see each file's description for limits.
subtitle: Pilot legal ontology, 8 Indonesian bankruptcy cases and a JPAIS retrieval test
